Grizzly Peak Cyclists Monday TI Lap

Emeryville, CA · Road

Grizzly Peak Cyclists Monday TI Lap is a road group ride in Emeryville, CA. It rolls every Monday at 5:25 pm from Emeryville, opposite IKEA. About 16 miles, faster T to moderate, with short regroups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: faster T to moderate, with short regroups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Grizzly Peak Cyclists Monday TI Lap group ride

A 16-mile Monday evening lap that starts in Emeryville opposite IKEA. The club rates it as a faster T pace down to moderate, with short regroups. The evening schedule runs to early November.
